transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve been having trouble with driving over high bridges. I keep planning my days around avoiding them, and if I can’t, I just kind of grip the wheel and get through it.
Is your fear limited to driving over high bridges?
Mostly, yeah. It’s those high bridges over the bay. I know they’re built fine and people drive them every day, but when I get close, my mind goes to… like the car could go over the side.
When you’re driving over a high bridge, do you ever suddenly get a surge of intense panic?
Yeah… pretty much right away. As soon as I see the bridge coming up, my chest tightens, my hands get sweaty on the wheel, and I just stare straight ahead, like I just need to get to the other side.
Do these panic-like surges ever happen when you’re not approaching or driving over a high bridge?
No… not really. It’s pretty much when I see the bridge coming up, or I’m getting onto it. That’s when my chest tightens and my hands start sweating.
Do you go out of your way to avoid driving over high bridges?
Yeah. I try to plan my day so I don’t have to take those bridges. If there’s no way around it, I just… grip the wheel and get through it.
